items.title: Fable 5.1 Solves the Cyphral Distich, a 370-year-old cipher
items.summary: Fable 5.1 has successfully decrypted the Cyphral Distich, a cipher that has puzzled cryptographers for over three centuries. This breakthrough highlights the advancements in AI-driven cryptography, showcasing the potential for AI to tackle complex historical challenges.

items.title: Registration without a phone number on Signal will use zero-knowledge proofs
items.summary: Signal has announced a new registration method that allows users to sign up without a phone number, utilizing zero-knowledge proofs to enhance privacy. This development is significant for developers focused on user privacy and security in messaging applications.

items.title: OpenArch – PyTorch implementations of modern LLM architectures
items.summary: OpenArch has been released, providing PyTorch implementations of various modern LLM architectures, which can greatly assist developers in building and experimenting with language models. This open-source resource is a valuable addition for those working in AI and machine learning.

items.title: Apple's Dimensional Drawings
items.summary: Apple has released a set of dimensional drawings that provide detailed specifications for accessory manufacturers. This resource is crucial for web developers and engineers involved in creating compatible products, ensuring a seamless integration with Apple devices.

items.title: Bad benchmarks and evals: Senior SWE-Bench, napkin math, and winter tires
items.summary: A new blog post discusses the pitfalls of poor benchmarking practices in software engineering, emphasizing the importance of accurate evaluations for system performance. This insight is vital for engineers looking to improve their methodologies and ensure reliable results.
